QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_32

question.text: Section 5.10 requires a Social Impact Assessment firm's quality control system to address ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Leadership responsibilities for quality within the firm
Maximising partner bonuses based on client-acquisition volume
Acceptance and continuance of end-user relationships and engagement-scope determination

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.10 lists six mandatory QC policy areas: (a) leadership responsibilities for quality, (b) ethical requirements, (c) acceptance/continuance of engagements including scope, (d) human resources including experts, (e) engagement performance including audit trail, (f) monitoring. Partner-bonus optimisation is nowhere in the list and would risk subordinating quality to commercial incentives. The Trap: A, B, D are all in the list. C is a commercial KPI that would run against the QC objective — a trap distractor. Cross-Exam Context: ICAI financial-audit SQC 1 has similar QC components; XXIII adapts them to SIA firms. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Build a one-page QC policy statement mapping your firm's procedures against the six Section 5.10 pillars — ICAI SIAB peer-review teams often ask for exactly this document as the opening artefact.
